body.p: This paper is being filed in response to the Restriction Requirement dated October 16, 2023. Claims 1-20 are currently pending. No claims are being amended, cancelled, or added.
Restriction Requirement
The Restriction Requirement of October 16, 2023 requests election of one of the following groups under 35 U.S.C. 121:
- Group I, drawn to a drone delivery system/method, classified in B64U2101/60 - Group II, drawn to various heliostat systems generating electricity, classified in H02S20/30
- Group Ill, drawn to various thermal heliostat systems, classified in F24S30/45
- Group IV, drawn to the assembly of heliostats, classified in F24S2023/878
- Group V, drawn to a method of cleaning heliostat systems generating electricity, classified in H02S40/10
- Group VI, drawn to a method of cleaning thermal heliostat systems, classified in F24S40/20
- Group VII, drawn to a plant growing system, classified in A01 G9/243.

p.u: In an effort to advance prosecution and without conceding that the identified
roups are independent and/or distinct, Applicant respectfully elects Group I without traverse.

body.p: Species Elections

- Species Al, drawn to an attaching mating mechanism comprising a knob and gripper, see page 4 lines 16-22;
- Species A2, drawn to an attaching mating mechanism comprising a shaft, see page 5 lines 1-5; and
- Species A3, drawn to an attaching mating mechanism comprising a jaws, see page 5 lines 6-10;
And:
- Species Bl, drawn to a perch comprising bars, see figure 2B; and
- Species B2, drawn to a perch comprising a landing pad, see figure 11;
And:
- Species Cl, drawn to a heliostat remotely controlled, see page 19 lines 15-17; and
- Species C2, drawn to a heliostat with a self-contained controller, see page 19 lines 15- 17.

p.u: In an effort to advance prosecution and without conceding that the identified species are independent and/or distinct, Applicant respectfully elects Species A

body.p: This paper fully responds to the Restriction Requirement. Applicant reserves the right to file the non-elected embodiments in a divisional application.
